name: THE LAND OF DEATH
story: Our king traded the names of the dead for an endless reign. Now even the living are forgotten. Beneath his fortress lies the first shard of the Covenant. Will you free those he bound, or claim their strength?
epilogue: The bells of Vesper ring again. Every toll returns a name to the world.

name: THE LAND OF BEAUTY
story: We grew our paradise from the stolen years of Vesper. The Seraph guards the second shard, but its roots drink from every newborn dream. Will you break the garden's bargain or preserve its splendor?
epilogue: For the first time in a thousand years, the leaves of Lethiel turn gold.

name: THE LAND OF PROSPERITY
story: Aurelis bought its wealth with Vesper's dead and Lethiel's dreams. The Engine holds the final shard. The merchant council offers you its throne. Who deserves the power to rewrite our covenant?
choice_a: Give the Covenant to the people • +Mercy
epilogue: The gilded gates open. Beyond them, three peoples wait for a new beginning.
